desc.zh-CN: Gemini 2.5 Pro 是谷歌DeepMind人工智能研究团队发布的模型，采用的版本号是Gemini-2.5-Pro-Preview-05-06。
desc.en-US: Gemini 2.5 Pro is a model released by Google DeepMind artificial intelligence research team, using version number Gemini-2.5-Pro-Preview-05-06.

desc.zh-CN: Doubao-1.5全新深度思考模型，在数学、编程、科学推理等专业领域及创意写作等通用任务中表现突出，在AIME 2024、Codeforces、GPQA等多项权威基准上达到或接近业界第一梯队水平。
desc.en-US: The new deep thinking model Doubao-1.5 performs outstandingly in professional fields such as mathematics, programming, scientific reasoning, and general tasks such as creative writing. It has reached or is close to the industry's top tier level on multiple authoritative benchmarks such as AIME 2024, Codeforces, and GPQA

desc.zh-CN: Qwen3是Qwen系列中最新一代的大型语言模型，提供了一套全面的密集模型和MoE模型。
desc.en-US: Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models in Qwen series, offering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.

desc.zh-CN: DeepSeek-R1 是一个通过大规模强化学习（RL）训练的模型，没有监督微调（SFT）作为初步步骤，在数学、代码和推理任务方面的性能可与openai-o1媲美。
desc.en-US: DeepSeek-R1 is a model trained through large-scale Reinforcement Learning (RL) without using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) as an initial step. Its performance in mathematics, coding, and reasoning tasks is comparable to that of OpenAI-o1.

desc.zh-CN: o4-mini-high是OpenAI推出的推理模型o4-mini的高性能版本,提供更强大的推理能力和更高的计算资源。
desc.en-US: o4-mini-high is a high-performance version of the inference model o4-mini from OpenAI, providing stronger inference capabilities and higher computing resources.

desc.zh-CN: 文心X1的升级版X1 Turbo，性能提升的同时，具备更先进的思维链，问答、创作、逻辑推理、工具调用和多模态能力进一步增强。
desc.en-US: The upgraded version X1 Turbo of ERNIE X1 not only enhances performance, but also has a more advanced thinking chain, including question answering, creation, logical reasoning, tool calling, and multimodal capabilities.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen3是Qwen系列中最新一代的大型语言模型，提供了一套全面的密集模型和MoE模型。
desc.en-US: Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models in Qwen series, offering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.

desc.zh-CN: o3-mini-high是OpenAI推出的推理模型o3-mini的高性能版本,提供更强大的推理能力和更高的计算资源。
desc.en-US: o3-mini-high is a high-performance version of the inference model o3-mini from OpenAI, providing stronger inference capabilities and higher computing resources.

desc.zh-CN: GLM发布的新一代GLM-4-32B-0414系列模型，所采用的版本号为GLM-Z1-32B-0414。
desc.en-US: The new generation GLM-4-32B-0414 series model released by GLM adopts the version number GLM-Z1-32B-0414.

desc.zh-CN: DeepSeek-V3 多项评测成绩超越了 Qwen2.5-72B 和 Llama-3.1-405B 等其他开源模型，并在性能上和世界顶尖的闭源模型 GPT-4o 以及 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 不分伯仲。
desc.en-US: DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source models such as Qwen2.5-72B and Llama-3.1-405B in multiple evaluations and matches the performance of top-tier closed-source models like GPT-4 and Claude-3.5-Sonnet.

desc.zh-CN: Grok 3是xAI人工智能公司开发的Grok系列模型的第三代版本，是Grok 2的升级版。
desc.en-US: Grok 3 is the third generation version of the Grok series models developed by xAI Company, and is an upgraded version of Grok 2.

desc.zh-CN: 科大讯飞发布的推理模型星火X1，在原来数学任务国内领先基础上，推理、文本生成、语言理解等通用任务实现效果对标OpenAI o1和DeepSeek R1。
desc.en-US: The inference model Spark X1 released by iFlytek, on the basis of leading domestic mathematical tasks, benchmarks the performance of general tasks such as inference, text generation, and language understanding against OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek R1.

desc.zh-CN: 360发布的智脑2闭源模型，所使用版本号是360Zhinao2-O1.5。
desc.en-US: The closed source model of Zhinao2 released by 360. The version name used is 360Zhinao2-O1.5.

desc.zh-CN: 由OpenAI推出的GPT-4.1系列模型，在编码、指令遵循和长上下文方面有重大改进。
desc.en-US: The GPT-4.1 series models launched by OpenAI, which have significant improvements in encoding, instruction adherence, and long context.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen3是Qwen系列中最新一代的大型语言模型，提供了一套全面的密集模型和MoE模型。
desc.en-US: Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models in Qwen series, offering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.

desc.zh-CN: 由OpenAI推出的GPT-4.1系列模型，在编码、指令遵循和长上下文方面有重大改进。
desc.en-US: The GPT-4.1 series models launched by OpenAI, which have significant improvements in encoding, instruction adherence, and long context.

desc.zh-CN: Claude 3.7 Sonnet Thinking是Anthropic发布的混合推理智能模型Claude 3.7 Sonnet的Thinking版本。它具有最先进的编码技术，在内容生成、数据分析和规划方面都有重大改进。
desc.en-US: Claude 3.7 Sonnet Thinking is the Thinking version of the hybrid inference intelligent model Claude 3.7 Sonnet released by Anthropic. It has the most advanced encoding technology and significant improvements in content generation, data analysis, and planning.

desc.zh-CN: GLM发布的新一代GLM-4-32B-0414系列模型，所采用的版本号为GLM-4-32B-0414。
desc.en-US: The new generation GLM-4-32B-0414 series model released by GLM adopts the version number GLM-4-32B-0414.

desc.zh-CN: 360Zhinao3-7B-O1.5模型，不止是数学和科学的单点模型，在通用能力上表现优秀，可以在端侧应用上发挥更大价值。
desc.en-US: The 360Zhinao3-7B-O1.5 model is not just a mathematical and scientific single point model, but also performs well in general ability and can exert greater value in end side applications.

desc.zh-CN: Gemma 是来自谷歌的一系列轻量级、最先进的开源模型家族，这些模型基于创建Gemini模型相同的研究和技术构建而成。
desc.en-US: Gemma is a family of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models from Google, built from the same research and technology used to create the Gemini models.

desc.zh-CN: Llama 4模型是自回归语言模型，它使用混合专家（MoE）架构，并结合了原生多模态的早期融合
desc.en-US: The Llama 4 models are auto-regressive language models that use a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture and incorporate early fusion for native multimodality

desc.zh-CN: Step-2-16K 是由阶跃星辰出品的 API 模型，模型版本号为 step-2-16k
desc.en-US: Step-2-16K is an API model produced by Step Star, with the model version number being step-2-16k.

desc.zh-CN: 星火认知大模型是由科大讯飞出品的 API 模型，所使用的版本号是星火 v4.0
desc.en-US: The Spark Cognitive Large Model is an API model produced by iFlytek, with the version number being Spark v4.0.

desc.zh-CN: Minimmax-text-01是一个功能强大的语言模型，总共有4560亿个参数，其中每个令牌激活459亿个参数。为了更好地解锁模型的长上下文功能，Minimmax-text-01采用了一种混合架构，结合了Lightning Attention、Softmax Attention和混合专家（MoE）。
desc.en-US: MiniMax-Text-01 is a powerful language model with 456 billion total parameters, of which 45.9 billion are activated per token. To better unlock the long context capabilities of the model, MiniMax-Text-01 adopts a hybrid architecture that combines Lightning Attention, Softmax Attention and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE).

百灵语言大模型是通用语言大模型，已通过生成式人工智能上线备案。基于万亿级Token语料训练而练成，所使用的版本号是Bailing-Lite-20250220

desc.en-US: The Llama 4 models are auto-regressive language models that use a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture and incorporate early fusion for native multimodality

desc.en-US: Moonshot-v1-16K is an API model produced by Moonshot, with the model version number being moonshot-v1-16k.
